items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: George Duvivier, Major Holly, Slam Stewart, listening to everything

ctx.x: Well the camp that I went to started me a little bit on here’s your scales, here’s some forms to use, a lot of listening, like to Ray and Paul Chambers and Mingus and Oscar

Pettiford and Leroy Vinnegar, and George Duvivier, Major Holly, Slam Stewart, listening to everything that I could get my hands on. I mean that was most of it. I really didn’t get any formal bass lessons until I came down to UCSD for my master’s degree. Up until that point it had really been kind of [inaudible]. I’d listening a lot, I loved the music, I sang more than played actually when I was in Montana. I mean I played, because I was the only bass player around. But as far as really knowing the right technique…
Did you study piano along the way, harmony, that kind of thing?
